subject: general
question: Starting from point X, Aditya walked 30 m towards the south. He then took a left turn and walked 20 m. Then, he took a right turn and walked 10 m. He then took another right turn and walked 40 m. Finally, he took one last right turn and walked another 40 m to reach point Y. How far and in which direction is point X from point Y ? (All turns are 90 degree turns Only)
solution:
From the given information:

Step 1: Starting from point X, Aditya walked 30 m towards the south. He then took a left turn and walked 20 m.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/414a8d58f75bb3860c3dfbe3718f4df5c3723cc499cd61a36b6d771c6a1dc293.png] 

Step 2: Then, he took a right turn and walked 10 m. He then took another right turn and walked 40 m.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f15dee61115328eceecdd4388533d11ed7c76a444001a7d8d26a298079dfe83a.png] 

Step 3: Finally, he took one last right turn and walked another 40 m to reach point Y.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8b0111f584c43e9eba956c091c16236574dea1b9746a3266878dbe97c2a5397a.png] 

Distance from Y to X = 40m - 20m = 20m

From the diagram, we can see that **X is 20m toward the east of Y.**

Hence the correct answer is **option 2)**
